children.title: Cycle 76 · Investigating Path-Dependent Preference Formation via Hypothesis Revision

detail.title: Investigating Path-Dependent Preference Formation via Hypothesis Revision
detail.summary: This cycle advances project proj-mem-pref-01 by revising hypothesis hyp-mem-pref-01 based on inconclusive numerical observations, proposing a refined experiment to further test divergence slope dynamics under structured memory-augmented conditions, and setting a research direction for continued empirical testing.
